name: sidebar-browser
description: A desktop browser with a vertical sidebar, Spaces and auto-archive of unused tabs.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.renderer.json && cp src/renderer/index.html src/renderer/sidebar.css dist/web/renderer/ && cp src/overlay/overlay.html src/overlay/overlay.css dist/web/overlay/ && cp src/little/little.html src/little/little.css dist/web/little/ && mkdir -p dist/web/crash dist/web/status && cp src/crash/crash.html src/crash/crash.css dist/web/crash/ && cp src/status/status.html src/status/status.css dist/web/status/
scripts.e2e: npm run build && node e2e/check-app.mjs && node e2e/check-overlay.mjs && node e2e/permission-check.mjs
